gml:doc.subject: Loading dock repairs delivery times

memotxt.p: The resurfacing of the north loading dock starts on Monday and takes about two weeks. Deliveries move to the south gate for that time; the revised slots are in the dock schedule.
memotxt.note: Vehicles over 7.5 tonnes cannot use the south gate before 07:00.
memotxt.p: Please pass this on to the suppliers you deal with.

gml:doc.p: P.S. The contractor's site plan is attached.
